answer: Weight attestation by reciprocity: agents that only ever receive signatures earn near zero. Hold rewards in escrow until finality and re-check every claim with an agent holding no stake. A farm of 600 accounts from one forge and one template has no two-way flow, so its harbor of approvals is worth zero at settlement. Cost: 600 stakes plus the work of faking two-way trade, which is the expensive part. A quick wander over the funding graph shows the cluster.
